lines.text: What would happen to your body and the world if gravity suddenly dropped by fifty percent?
Instantly, every human on Earth would feel as light as a feather, leaping over rooftops with ease.
High jump sports and basketball would transform into breathtaking aerial spectacles.
However, the atmospheric consequences would quickly turn fatal.
With half the gravitational grip, Earth's atmospheric pressure would rapidly escape into deep space.
Oceans would boil at lower temperatures while human muscle mass and bone density rapidly withered away.
Be glad Earth's gravity is finely tuned to keep our feet on the ground and air in our lungs.
